text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I came to the shrine with Symboli Kris S, who hasn't been performing well lately. There are unusually many visitors today.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...They seem to be—tourists from overseas.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "The shrine maiden was being asked something, but unable to understand the language, she seemed to be struggling to respond."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...I'm going to step out for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...If it's alright with you, I... will speak.

text_block_list.name: Shrine Maiden
text_block_list.text: Ah... Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...Pardon the intrusion.
I will be handling things—in their stead."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Symboli Kris S spoke to the foreign tourists in English.

text_block_list.name: Foreign Woman
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, thank you.
Prayer, you say... I wonder what that entails?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"Understood. A prayer—
is a ritual to convey one's wishes to God."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ""From what I've read in books—though the exact customs seem to vary by shrine—""

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"One often enters the main shrine――and has
the Shinto priest recite a purification prayer."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"‘...If you wish to apply—
I will handle the paperwork for you.’"

text_block_list.name: Foreign Woman
text_block_list.text: "Thank you! I would love that!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Handled it――without a hitch.
choice_data_list: You sure know a lot about shrines.
You sure know a lot about shrines.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Before... I studied Japanese culture
and researched shrines as well...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S turned her gaze toward the shrine's main hall.
A foreign woman heading for a prayer ritual
noticed her and waved enthusiastically with a bright smile.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I'm glad it was useful.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her murmured voice sounded strangely refreshed.
Thanks to that, Symboli Kris S was able
to regain her composure.

text_block_list.name: Foreign Woman
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, thank you.
I'd love to hear about the construction of the main shrine's roof."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: "...The roof's structure?"

text_block_list.name: Foreign Woman
text_block_list.text:
"Yes! Please tell me all the details!
I'm so deeply fascinated by traditional Japanese architecture!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...Forgive my lack of knowledge.
It seems I won't be of much help..."

text_block_list.name: Foreign Woman
text_block_list.text:
"Right... I understand.
Don't worry about it..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Despite saying that, the woman walked away with slumped shoulders...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I thought... I had learned Japanese culture...
Yet it wasn't enough...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S looked apologetic.
Perhaps dwelling on this weighed on her,
as she was unable to regain her form...
